content_sections.heading: About LGBRIMH
content_sections.text: LGBRIMH is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Tezpur, Assam. The post is part of the multi-centric research project "HEADS – Human-in-the-loop Evaluation of Assisted Depression Screening", funded by the Wellcome Trust, United Kingdom. The project's participating institutions are NIMHANS, Bengaluru (lead institution), IIT Kharagpur and LGBRIMH, Tezpur. Its aim is to develop and evaluate a multilingual, human-in-the-loop, AI-based system for assisting depression assessment, using recorded clinical interviews, automatic speech recognition, machine translation and clinician-led diagnostic reasoning. LGBRIMH, Tezpur, is the implementing site for this notice.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post with 4 vacancies. It does not give a category-wise break-up, and it states that the number of posts is provisional and may be increased or decreased as per project requirements, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. All eligibility conditions (qualification, registration, age and experience) are reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Registration and DNB conditions: Valid registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) or a State Medical Council. It must be valid on the last date of receipt of applications and at the time of joining. For DNB candidates, verification/equivalence of the DNB qualification by NBEMS is as per the prevailing rules and notifications in force. Desirable qualifications: Proficiency in speaking, reading and writing Assamese and/or Bengali, considered crucial for local patient recruitment, clinical interviewing and data collection at the Tezpur site. Experience in psychiatric interviewing and clinical research. Experience in administering structured and semi-structured instruments such as QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9. Experience in digital data collection, handling of audio recordings, and redaction/de-identification of recorded data. Experience in clinical reasoning annotation and quality control of transcripts and translations. Age limit: the upper age limit is 45 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen and other categories is as per the extant orders of the Government of India. The notice prints no minimum age. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated emolument is ₹1,38,659/- per month, as per the approved project budget and the MoU. It is fixed under the approved project budget. No other allowance, benefit or pay-linked component is admissible over and above it, except as expressly provided in the project sanction. Tenure: initially for 1 (one) year, extendable up to 24 months or the project duration, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Extension beyond the first year is subject to periodic performance review, project requirements and availability of funds from the funding agency. Nature of engagement: purely contractual, temporary and project-funded, and co-terminus with the project. It gives no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption or continuation in LGBRIMH or in any other project or post of the Institute. Full-time work: appointees work exclusively and full-time for the HEADS project and are not deputed to non-project duties of the Institute. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. CPD: as mandated by the funding agency, 10 (ten) days per year are available to each appointee for approved Continuing Professional Development activities. Termination: either party may terminate by giving one month's notice or payment of one month's consolidated emoluments in lieu. The Institute reserves the right to terminate without notice in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or closure/curtailment of the project or its funding. Accommodation: residential accommodation on the campus may be provided subject to availability and on payment of charges as per Institute rules. It cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave: regulated as per the rules applicable to contractual/project staff of the Institute and the conditions of the project sanction.

content_sections.heading: LGBRIMH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Senior Residents work under the supervision of the Site Principal Investigator at LGBRIMH and are required, inter alia, to: Conduct structured psychiatric assessments and clinical interviews of study participants using standardised tools, including QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9, in accordance with the approved study protocol. Undertake audio-recording of clinical interviews and ensure the secure storage, handling, transfer and de-identification of all participant interview data, as per the project's data management plan. Carry out diagnostic and clinical reasoning annotation of recorded interviews, and perform quality control of Assamese/Bengali transcriptions and their translations. Participate in inter-rater reliability and harmonisation exercises, multi-centric research meetings (physical/virtual), and training programmes organised by the lead and partner institutions. Contribute clinical inputs to the multidisciplinary AI development and evaluation pipeline in collaboration with the teams at NIMHANS, Bengaluru and IIT Kharagpur. Maintain study records, case report forms and documentation, and perform any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident (Psychiatry) posts has LGBRIMH announced?
faq.answer: LGBRIMH has announced 04 (Four) posts of Senior Resident (Psychiatry) for the Wellcome-funded HEADS project. The number of posts is provisional and may be increased or decreased as per project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the LGBRIMH Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The last date is 20 November 2026. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] on or before that date, and late applications are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree and a Postgraduate Degree/Diploma in Psychiatry (MD / DNB / Diploma in Psychological Medicine or equivalent Diploma in Psychiatry) recognised by NMC / NBEMS. They also need valid NMC or State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. It is relaxable for reserved categories as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the HEADS project Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The consolidated emolument is ₹1,38,659/- per month. No other allowance, benefit or pay-linked component is admissible over and above it, except as expressly provided in the project sanction.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply by email to [email protected] with the prescribed subject line and the scanned documents attached, preferably merged into a single PDF. The subject line is "Application for Senior Resident (Psychiatry) HEADS Project – Human-in-the-loop Evaluation of Assisted Depression Screening".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview, preceded by screening of applications. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email on 23 November 2026, and the hybrid interview is on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual, temporary and project-funded. It is initially for 1 year, extendable up to 24 months or the project duration, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to regular appointment or absorption.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no Travelling Allowance / Dearness Allowance is paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can a government employee apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates employed in Central/State Government Departments, PSUs or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview, failing which they shall not be allowed to appear.
